title: Read a custom backend snapshot
summary: Execute the Host-registered project.snapshot-card JSON plan: read a bound Project target at an expected revision and return its snapshot. A package cannot import a backend module or add arbitrary execution.

carrier.notes: Reached through luc_invoke after discovery and description. Schemas describe the result before the wrapper; Runtime context and authority are supplied separately by the Host.

replaceability.why: Backend definitions and proven context/dispatcher ports are registered by trusted Host code. A creator's layer on the Official package may add a sandboxed program (luc_tool_program) that answers for the capability while keeping its pinned backend_id, input/output schemas and authority.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, 2026-10-24; sandboxed program replacement wired via luc_tool_program (lumeri_runtime/luc_custom.py:364-400, lumeri_runtime/luc_interface_gate.py:35-44)

operations.name: snapshot
operations.notes: No timeout is enforced on the synchronous read plan. Retrying reads the expected target revision again; no result cache is maintained. The caller supplies target and expected_project_revision, never account/session binding. Runtime Host codes may propagate from the dispatcher. The module is off by default and has no executable availability until proven Host ports are bound.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters before the model result is clipped; the cut notice is appended

invariants.text: The snapshot plan dispatches the exact registered project.read payload under a proven Host binding; a supplied foreign project_id is refused.

break: A replacement program exits, exceeds its deadline or returns an invalid result/refusal.
The trusted binding is absent, changed or refuses the invocation.
An input, result or Host context fails validation.
failure.notes: When a layer's program breaks, the adapter records the break in LucBreaker and falls back to the Official custom-backend implementation for the rest of the start.

conformance.notes: Verified across Official adapter tests and sandboxed program on/off/break replacement tests.

known_deviations.text: The adapter can load with unbound Host ports and truthfully describe runtime_bound=false. Such a loaded capability cannot execute: it raises E_LUC_CUSTOM_RUNTIME. Enabling the Official package alone is not availability.

open_questions.text: Define production CustomHostPorts before claiming this capability is usable; the snapshot remains an opaque project.document-owned shape.

snapshot.description: Host project.read target snapshot, with fields determined by the target kind; see iface:project.document/v1.
